title: Graduate Engineer, Civil
content_text:
Kick-start your engineering career with Colliers Engineering & Design. As a Graduate Civil Engineer, you'll work alongside experienced professionals on a diverse range of land development projects, helping shape residential communities, industrial precincts, commercial developments, and urban infrastructure across Australia. From day one, you'll gain hands-on experience in civil design, site grading, stormwater drainage, earthworks, roads, and utility servicing while developing your technical skills and industry knowledge through mentorship and structured learning opportunities.
What You'll Be Doing: Assisting with the design and delivery of land development projects; Preparing civil engineering drawings and design documentation; Contributing to road, drainage, earthworks and utility design; Supporting project teams with technical analysis and reporting; Collaborating with planners, surveyors, environmental specialists and engineers; Participating in site inspections and client meetings.
About You: Recently completed or completing a degree in Civil Engineering; Passion for land development and civil design; Strong problem-solving and communication skills; Keen to learn and develop your technical capabilities; Experience with AutoCAD, Civil 12D or similar software is advantageous.
Ready to kick-start your career? Apply via the link below. Please be advised that applications will only be accepted directly rather than via recruitment agencies.

title: Junior Civil Engineer - Melbourne VIC
content_text:
Senversa Pty Ltd is an Australian employee-owned environmental consulting firm with offices in Melbourne, Geelong, Sydney, Newcastle, Adelaide, Perth, and Brisbane. Our Civil & Environmental Engineering Team delivers innovative and integrated engineering solutions for the waste, resources and renewables industries from project conception through construction of waste containment, soil, and water storage/retention projects nationwide. Our team specialise in geosynthetic solutions across a range of applications.
We have an exciting opportunity for a passionate Graduate or junior career professional, to work as a part of our National Engineering team based in Melbourne, VIC.
In this role, you will gain exposure to a diverse range of projects including: Geosynthetic containment and capping designs in waste, resource and renewables industries; Landfill design and advisory support; Superintendency, Contract Management and Construction Support; Project feasibility studies.
Does this sound like you? In your final year of university in a course related to Environmental or Civil Engineering, or a related field, or have up to 2 years of experience; Excellent analytical, research, and problem-solving skills; Strong written and verbal communication skills; Ability to work independently and as part of a team; Hold a valid Australian driver's licence.
If you are interested in these exciting opportunities and meet the above criteria, please submit your CV and cover letter.

title: Cadet Drafter, Urban Infrastructure
content_text:
We are seeking to engage a Cadet Drafter to join our Urban Infrastructure team in Parramatta to contribute to the development and production of some of the largest urban infrastructure projects across New South Wales.
Key Responsibilities: Assisting in the preparation of schematic and production drawings under supervision; Performing general office duties under supervision; Assisting more senior drafters with the analysis of tasks and problems; Production of construction-level documentation; Check print procedures; Issuing procedures; Vault data management processes.
About You: Enrolment in an Advanced Diploma or Associate Degree; Willingness to learn CAD technologies, with emphasis on the Autodesk suite of products; Ability to interpret and carry out instructions; Effective communication and interpersonal skills to work within a diverse and multidisciplinary environment; Ability to adapt to changing situations; Full working rights.
How To Apply: click Apply Now and follow the prompts. Please do not forward resumes directly to SMEC employees/managers.
